title: Control-verb vocabulary (issue #553, EPIC #551)
description: The one declaration of every control verb. Closed sets: effect_classes, refusals. A verb outside this file does not exist.

effect_classes.description: Closed map of effect class -> meaning. The class set is exactly these four keys.

refusals.description: Closed map of HTTP refusal code -> reason. A verb may cite only these codes.

id.description: `<family>.<action>`. ADR-0025 D2: the API resource segment is `fleet`; the action segment is owned here.

source.description: The file that implements the local lever.

local.description: The local subcommand name in that file.

capability.description: identity/rbac capability the caller must hold, `resource:action`.

audit.description: Action recorded on the existing rails. MUST be non-null for every non-read verb and null for a read (ADR-0025 D3).

exposed.description: May this verb be reached over the control API (RC-3)? false requires why_not_exposed.

why_not_exposed.description: Required when exposed is false: a verb is never silently dropped.

immediate.description: Terminates without a graceful drain (e.g. kill vs stop).

refusals.description: Subset of the closed refusal-code set above; must include 401/403/503 unless justified in `note`.

note.description: Why this verb is declared the way it is. Optional; never a substitute for a field.
